sourceFields.SampleCollectionMethod/MethodName: Harrel's Benthic Macroinvertebrate Sample Collection Procedure
sourceFields.SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Benthic macroinvertebrates were collected seasonally using a petite Ponar dredge (15.24 cm by 15.24 cm).  Six samples were collected at each station.  Each sample was washed through a No. 30 mesh wash bucket, placed in quart jars, and preserved and stained with a mixture of 10 percent formalin and rose bengal dye (Mason and Yevich, 1967).  The samples were later washed in the laboratory through a No. 30 U.S. Standard Soil Sieve.  The organisms were later picked and stored in 70 percent ethanol until they were sorted, identified, and enumerated.  Harrel, R.C. and S.D. Commander; 1980; Water Quality Monitoring in the Big Thicket National Preserve (4 of 5), Turkey Creek Unit; Lamar Univerity; 94p
